news_1_body:
在最近于泰国曼谷落幕的2026亚洲食品博览会上，YuKoLi 携其全新第五代智能烹饪机器人惊艳亮相，成为全场焦点。本届博览会吸引了来自东南亚、南亚和中东地区的2000多家餐饮服务公司。

第五代智能烹饪机器人较前代实现了全面升级，配备全新AI烹饪引擎，支持超过800道食谱，涵盖中餐、东南亚餐和西餐。凭借精确温控系统和自适应翻炒技术，该设备烹饪一致率达到99.5%，远超行业平均水平。

YuKoLi 展位在整个展会期间人潮涌动，来自泰国、越南、马来西亚和印度尼西亚的200多个餐饮品牌代表现场体验了该设备。多家连锁餐饮集团当场表达了合作意向，首批50台设备预计将在六个月内交付并投入使用。

YuKoLi 首席执行官在接受媒体采访时表示：“我们的目标不仅仅是提供一台智能设备，更是为餐饮企业打造完整的智能厨房解决方案。通过AI技术与IoT平台的深度融合，YuKoLi 帮助客户实现从备餐到装盘的全程标准化和自动化，在确保每道菜高品质和一致性的同时，大幅降低人力成本。”

此外，YuKoLi 在博览会上还发布了全新云管理平台，支持远程设备监控、自动维护警报和一键更新菜谱，进一步提升商业厨房的运营效率和智能化水平。

一家领先的东南亚餐饮连锁店宣布在其所有86家门店大规模部署 YuKoLi 自动化烹饪生产线，这标志着该地区厨房自动化的商业化进程中的一个里程碑。该项目总投资额超过1200万美元，是 YuKoLi 在东南亚市场历史上最大的一笔订单。

该连锁店在泰国、越南和柬埔寨经营三大业务板块——快餐、休闲餐饮和高端餐饮。通过引入 YuKoLi 自动化烹饪生产线，该品牌在其中央厨房实现了从食材准备、自动烹饪到成品包装的全自动化生产，使每家门店的日餐产量提高了3倍，同时将人力成本降低了65%。

该项目分三个阶段进行：第一阶段涉及30家旗舰店的设备安装和调试，第二阶段覆盖其余56家门店，第三阶段将推出 YuKoLi 云管理平台，实现整个网络的统一调度和数据分析。

该连锁店的运营总监评论道：“YuKoLi 的设备在试用期间表现非常出色。食品质量的高度一致性显著提高了客户满意度。更重要的是，YuKoLi 团队提供了全面的售后服务和技��支持，让我们在整个部署过程中充满信心。”

YuKoLi 东南亚区域总监透露，该项目的成功实施为公司在该地区的扩张奠定了坚实基础。目前多个国家的多家餐饮公司正在洽谈类似的大规模自动化项目，预计在2026年下半年将迎来新一轮订单。

news_3_body:
经过严格的六个月的审核和现场检查流程，YuKoLi 所有产品成功获得了ISO 9001:2015国际质量管理体系认证和欧盟CE安全合规认证，这标志着公司在质量控制和国际市场准入能力方面的一个重要里程碑。

ISO 9001:2015认证要求公司在质量管理的各个方面达到国际标准，包括研发设计、制造、供应链管理和售后服务。审核机构对 YuKoLi 的质量管理体系给予了高度评价，特别肯定了公司在原材料追溯、标准化生产过程控制和发货前产品检验方面的严谨态度。

CE认证是欧盟市场的强制性准入要求，涉及电气安全、机械安全和电磁兼容性等多个维度的严格测试。YuKoLi 所有智能烹饪设备均成功通过了每一项测试类别，证明产品在安全性和可靠性方面达到了世界级标准。

YuKoLi 质量管理总监表示：“获得双认证是我们长期坚持质量优先战略的重要成果。我们投入了大量资源建设质量管理体系，从供应商筛选到最终产品交付的每一步都有严格的标准和流程。这些认证不仅是对我们现有工作的认可，更是持续改进的动力。”

YuKoLi 目前正在推进美国UL认证和日本JIS认证的申请，预计在2026年底完成。完成后，公司将在全球主要市场拥有全面的认证体系，为进一步的国际市场拓展提供有力支持。

sr_faq1_q: 没有厨师经验的人能操作设备吗？
sr_faq1_a: 可以。菜谱预设了加热和翻炒时间——选择菜品，加入食材，按下启动。三步即可出餐。新手在30分钟内即可学会独立操作，完全不需要厨师背景。
sr_faq2_a: 价格因型号和配置而异。请通过WhatsApp或在线报价与我们联系，获取准确方案。一般来说，小型餐厅初创只需1–2台设备，投资门槛很低。
sr_faq3_a: 台面式设备到货即插即用，无需专业安装。订单48小时内发货，交付时间3–7天。
sr_faq4_q: 保修期多长？如果坏了怎么办？
sr_faq4_a: YuKoLi提供整机1年保修，核心部件（IGBT模块、电磁线圈、锅体）3年保修。经过多年迭代，所有易损部位都经过了强化。快拆设计随附免费备件。非人为损坏由本地售后团队快速免费上门维修，10个仓库支持快速响应。
sr_faq5_a: 设备内置1000+预设菜谱，也支持自定义菜谱输入。保存您自主研发的加热和翻炒参数，确保每份出品一致。
sr_faq6_a: YuKoLi提供业界领先的商用电磁和天然气产品线。电磁系列热效率达90%以上；燃气系列具备顶级燃烧性能。实际消耗取决于烹饪需求、频率和当地能源价格——请咨询销售部门获取最经济的厨房能源方案。

ckc_equipment_title: 为有限空间选择多品牌兼容设备
ckc_equipment_desc: 并非所有设备都适合云厨房。台面占用空间、品牌切换速度和出餐效率——这三个指标比什么都重要。
ckc_eq1_body: 任何云厨房的首台设备——适合台面，覆盖多个品牌的炒菜需求。只需更换配方即可切换品牌。
ckc_eq2_body: 只有当品牌日订单超过150份时才需要。更大容量意味着高峰期批次更少——每班次多出几十份订单。
ckc_eq3_body: 汤面、焖菜和粥品品牌的必备设备。餐前炖煮并保温——高峰期直接出品，不占用炒锅。
ckc_eq4_body: 专门用于炸鸡和薯条品牌——精确控温，出品稳定。云厨房高利润品类。
ckc_eq5_body: 多品牌共享厨房的备餐主力——在高峰期前10分钟准备好所有品牌的食材。一个炒锅完成后，切换到下一个品牌。
ckc_eq6_body: 如果您还有蒸制或煮面需求，该设备可同时运行。
ckc_scenarios_title: 不同云厨房模式，不同设备配置
ckc_scenario_1_body: 纯外卖模式——2-3台设备覆盖核心菜单项目，紧凑高效。
ckc_scenario_2_body: 一厨房运营多个品牌——需要多台设备+快速配方切换。
ckc_scenario_3_body: 为多家门店集中生产——需要高产能设备+生产线配置。
ckc_scenario_4_body: 批量烹饪+配送——需要炖煮和保温设备。

ckc_faq3_q: 出餐速度能应对高峰配送量吗？

ckc_faq4_a: 电磁设备无明火，大幅减少油烟排放。在某些场景下，可以完全避免传统的消防改造——降低开店门槛。

ckc_faq6_a: 是的。支持定制配方输入——在推出新品牌时快速添加专有菜品参数。

sr_pain2_title: TRANSLATE: Kitchen Too Small for Equipment
sr_pain2_body: TRANSLATE: A 10–15 m² kitchen has to fit prep tables, stoves, and a packing area. Traditional gas ranges turn the whole kitchen into an oven in summer — staff can barely stand it.
sr_pain3_title: TRANSLATE: New Chef Means New Flavor
sr_pain3_body: TRANSLATE: Regulars come for your signature taste. Today Chef A cooks it, tomorrow Chef B — the regular takes one bite and asks "Did you change chefs?" That's how you lose customers.
sr_pain4_title: TRANSLATE: Bottlenecked at Peak Service Speed
sr_pain4_body: TRANSLATE: At 11:30, delivery and dine-in orders flood in simultaneously. Two woks can't keep up. Customers wait 20 minutes with no food — they cancel the order, and bad reviews arrive the next day.
sr_pain5_title: TRANSLATE: Kitchen Like a Furnace, Monthly Bills Shocking?
sr_pain5_body: TRANSLATE: Open-flame kitchens hit 40°C+ in summer. Staff can only endure 2 hours. Gas cylinders need replacing several times a month, electricity bills keep climbing — that's how profits get eaten.
sr_pain6_title: TRANSLATE: Equipment Breaks = Business Stops, No One to Fix It?
sr_pain6_body: TRANSLATE: At noon the stove breaks down. The next batch is prepped but can't cook. You call the supplier — they say 3–5 days. How do you serve for the next 3 days?
sr_solution_title: TRANSLATE: How to Survive the Lunch Rush in a 15 m² Kitchen?

sr_feat1_body: TRANSLATE: Countertop wok, induction cooker, stewing machine — fried rice, char kway teow, fried chicken, braised pork, all done on the countertop. No floor space needed.

sr_eq2_body: TRANSLATE: Soups, braised dishes, pre-prepared meals. Stew before service and hold in the insulated unit — serve directly at lunch without occupying the wok.
sr_eq3_body: TRANSLATE: Fried chicken, french fries, snacks — if your menu has fried items, you need this. Precise temperature, reliable batches every time.

support_faq_cat_1_q1: TRANSLATE: How do I choose the right commercial kitchen equipment?
support_faq_cat_1_a1: TRANSLATE: Consider these factors: 1) Cuisine type — induction wok ranges for Chinese stir-fry, ovens and fryers for Western baking, food processors for fast-casual prep; 2) Daily output — estimate capacity based on daily covers; 3) Kitchen footprint — countertop models save space, floor-standing units offer higher throughput; 4) Power supply — confirm whether your site has 220 V or 380 V. Submit your requirements via our Get a Quote page and our engineers will recommend the optimal configuration.
support_faq_cat_1_q2: TRANSLATE: What is the difference between 220 V and 380 V equipment? How do I choose?
support_faq_cat_1_a2: TRANSLATE: 220 V (single-phase) suits small restaurants, cafés, and food stalls — plugs into standard mains power with easy installation. 380 V (three-phase) is designed for large commercial kitchens, central kitchens, and canteens where higher power, faster heating, and greater efficiency are needed; requires a certified electrician for installation. Our engineers conduct an on-site power survey before installation if you are unsure.
support_faq_cat_1_q3: TRANSLATE: Countertop vs. floor-standing equipment — which should I choose?
support_faq_cat_1_a3: TRANSLATE: Countertop units are compact and flexible, ideal for small kitchens with limited space; lower daily output and more budget-friendly. Floor-standing units deliver higher capacity and stability for mid-to-large commercial and central kitchens, typically with larger bowls and more powerful motors. Recommendation: kitchens under 30 m² should prioritize countertop equipment; above 30 m², choose floor-standing based on throughput needs. We provide complimentary layout planning for full-line configurations.

support_faq_cat_2_q4: TRANSLATE: How do I clean and maintain the equipment?
support_faq_cat_2_a4: TRANSLATE: Daily cleaning: Wipe surfaces with a damp cloth after each use; clean interior residue with food-grade cleaner. Daily inspection: Clear filters and drains; check blades and drive components. Weekly maintenance: Lubricate moving parts with food-grade oil; inspect power cables. Monthly deep clean: Fully disassemble and wash internal components; check consumable wear; perform function tests. Refer to the maintenance chapter of your operation manual for detailed schedules.
support_faq_cat_3_q1: TRANSLATE: What is the warranty policy?
support_faq_cat_3_a1: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi provides a comprehensive warranty program: 1-year whole-unit warranty covering all non-man-made faults; 3-year warranty on core components (IGBT module, induction coil, pot body); consumables (blades, filters, seals) are excluded from warranty but available at preferential pricing. During the warranty period, YuKoLi covers all repair labor and replacement part costs arising from quality issues.
support_faq_cat_3_q2: TRANSLATE: How do I purchase genuine spare parts?
support_faq_cat_3_q3: TRANSLATE: How soon can an on-site visit be arranged after reporting a fault?

On-site service: major Southeast Asian cities within 24–48 hours; remote areas within 3–5 working days. Every ticket is tracked end-to-end — check progress at any time.
support_faq_cat_3_q4: TRANSLATE: What should I do if the equipment fails to start or shuts down during operation?
support_faq_cat_3_a4: TRANSLATE: Won't start: 1) Check power connection; 2) Verify main switch and equipment switch; 3) Check for error codes on display. Shuts down during operation: 1) Overheat protection may have triggered — wait 10 minutes to cool, then restart; 2) Check water/oil levels; 3) Inspect power cables for looseness. If the issue persists, contact after-sales via WhatsApp immediately with photos of the nameplate and error code, and we will dispatch an engineer.

Custom equipment: 30–60 working days depending on complexity; shipped immediately upon completion. Spare parts: 48 hours for standard items. stewing_faq2_a: TRANSLATE: Electromagnetic precision temp control delivers far more stable results than open flame. In blind taste tests, most tasters find electromagnetic-stewed broth richer with less batch-to-batch variation.
stirfry_hero_desc: TRANSLATE: 107+ models from starter to smart. Smart temp control recreates traditional wok hei. One operator, multiple woks — 5x output boost. The preferred stir-fry equipment for Southeast Asian kitchens.
other_faq4_a: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi provides a 1-year whole-machine warranty and 3-year core component warranty. 10-warehouse coverage for fast after-sales response. Single-brand equipment means one contact for all service needs.
central_kitchen_scenario_1_desc: TRANSLATE: University, middle school, and primary school canteens — breakfast, lunch, dinner rotations plus between-meal service. Capacity 500–3,000. Recipes must balance nutrition with student taste preferences. Food safety is the top priority for parents and education authorities.
central_kitchen_scenario_2_desc: TRANSLATE: Enterprise parks and government canteens. Lunch is essential demand with concentrated peak flows. Capacity 300–5,000. Enough variety and fast turnover are critical — otherwise employees order delivery instead.
central_kitchen_scenario_3_desc: TRANSLATE: Hospital nutrition canteens and government cafeterias. High compliance standards, zero tolerance for food safety. Capacity 200–2,000. Special dietary needs (patient meals, low-fat, halal) — no room for errors.
central_kitchen_equipment_subtitle: TRANSLATE: What a mid-size central kitchen needs isn't the most expensive equipment — it's a combination that seamlessly links rice steaming, stir-frying, noodle cooking, and serving. Thaw at dawn, steam in the morning, stir-fry at lunch peak — one operator per line, seamless switching between batches.
app_cloud_pain_5_desc: TRANSLATE: Cloud kitchens rely heavily on part-time chefs for peak periods, but recruitment is difficult and training costs are high. Some operators report labor costs exceeding 30%, directly eating into profits.
menu_lab_pain_1_desc: TRANSLATE: Tom yum from a Bangkok chef tastes different at the Sydney branch. Thai sour-spicy, Malay coconut, Indonesian rich spices — every cuisine has different heat and seasoning. Chain owners dread hearing: "This branch doesn't taste like the flagship."
menu_lab_pain_4_desc: TRANSLATE: Same store, same recipe — Chef Zhang's version tastes different from Chef Li's. Shift change = flavor change. In multi-cuisine restaurants this is worse — each cuisine has its own "feel" that can't be taught verbally.
sr_hero_subtitle: TRANSLATE: Whether you run a delivery-only shop, community fast food, specialty store, or cloud kitchen — Southeast Asian small restaurants all face the same problem: the kitchen can't keep up, staff keep leaving. Which one are you?
sr_pain1_body: TRANSLATE: Experienced Southeast Asian chefs command high salaries — and the ones you train just leave. One sick day and the kitchen is paralyzed. Delivery orders pile up, dine-in customers wait, bad reviews follow.
support_faq_hero_desc: TRANSLATE: Equipment issue? Our intelligent FAQ system helps you find solutions fast. 80% of common issues are resolved instantly online; complex problems are automatically escalated to specialist engineers with end-to-end tracking until resolution.
support_faq_cat_1_a4: TRANSLATE: Yes. We offer OEM badging and ODM co-development partnerships. Customization covers exterior design, feature configuration, dimensional specifications, and control systems. Typical lead time is 30–60 working days depending on complexity. Contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email to discuss your customization requirements.
support_faq_cat_2_a1: TRANSLATE: Follow these steps for first use: 1) Inspect for shipping damage inside and out; 2) Verify voltage matches the nameplate before powering on; 3) Run idle for 5–10 minutes on first power-up and check for anomalies; 4) Familiarize yourself with buttons and parameter settings via the operation manual; 5) Clean the interior before putting into service. Our engineers provide on-site training during installation to ensure your staff can operate proficiently.
support_faq_cat_2_a2: TRANSLATE: Yes. YuKoLi smart devices support custom recipe import via USB or Wi-Fi. Create recipes on the control panel by setting temperature, time, stirring speed and other parameters, then save as preset programs. We also provide a built-in recipe library covering Chinese stir-fry, Western baking, Southeast Asian cuisines and more. Contact technical support for the recipe management tool if you need batch import.
support_faq_cat_2_a3: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi commercial equipment is designed for 24/7 continuous operation. We recommend a short rest and cleaning every 8–12 hours to maintain peak performance and extend service life. Built-in overheat protection automatically shuts down the unit if temperature exceeds safe limits; restart after cooling.
support_faq_cat_3_a2: TRANSLATE: Order through these channels: 1) Spare Parts Support page on this website; 2) WhatsApp our parts specialist; 3) Email sales.kitchen@yukoli.com. We stock 500+ genuine spare part SKUs in our Southeast Asia regional warehouse with 48-hour dispatch for standard parts. Provide your equipment model and photos of the required part to ensure precise matching.
support_faq_cat_4_a2: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi products are exported to 68+ countries and regions worldwide, with a focus on Southeast Asia including Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, Myanmar, and Cambodia. We also export to the Middle East, Africa, and South America. All export equipment carries CE, ISO, ROHS and other international certifications meeting import standards worldwide. Contact our sales team to confirm specific country availability.
